{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
sales_clean = sales[~sales['revenue_clean'].eq(999999.99)]

# Recompute converted: 1 only if status == 'completed'
sales_clean['converted_correct'] = (sales_clean['status'] == 'completed').astype(int)

# Now, compute the conversion rate for email and paid_search channels
# using only completed, non-refunded orders
email_rate = sales_clean[sales_clean['channel'] == 'email']['converted_correct'].mean()
paid_search_rate = sales_clean[sales_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted_correct'].mean()

# Compute the difference
difference = email_rate - paid_search_rate

# Print results
print(f"Email conversion rate (completed, non-refunded): {email_rate}")
print(f"Paid search conversion rate (completed, non-refunded): {paid_search_rate}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference}")"}
